# Synthetic estimate-pipeline fixtures

Every file here was authored from scratch for public automated tests. Geometry,
weights, identifiers, names, and approval metadata are invented and do not
derive from a production estimate, drawing, nest, RFQ, customer, vendor, or
operating company.

The profile uses obvious `Example` identity and explicitly synthetic test text.
No prices, rates, payment terms, vendor terms, or purchasing commitments appear
in these fixtures.
